name: Barbados

flag.description: Three equal vertical bands of ultramarine blue, gold and ultramarine blue, with a black trident head, its shaft broken off, in the centre of the gold band.
flag.symbolism: The blue bands represent the sea and sky and the gold band the sand; the broken trident, taken from the colonial badge of Britannia, symbolises the break from colonial rule.

hook: Barbados: a black trident with its shaft snapped off, standing on gold between two blue stripes, like Neptune breaking with the past.
trivia: The flag was designed by Grantley Prescod, whose entry won an open national competition before independence in 1966.
Barbados became a republic on 30 November 2021, replacing the British monarch as head of state with a president.
